en: The postcard displays a bustling harbor scene, with barrels and cargo on the docks, a steamship with a Swedish flag, horse-drawn carts, and people in early 20th-century attire. The backdrop features buildings and wooded hills. The text on the front reads 'Sundsvall. Parti från hamnen.' The reverse side has classic postcard formatting with a printed publisher's mark 'A.-B. Ernst G. Svanström, Stockholm.'
